classes.name: Stablecoin-платежи, FX и treasury liquidity
classes.customer_hypothesis: Платёжные платформы, merchants, казначейства и vault operators.
classes.product_hypothesis: Read-only treasury optimizer: сравнение маршрутов, взаимозачёт платежей, прогноз дефицита ликвидности и reconciliation; возможная модель оплаты за API/аналитику.
classes.clearing_application: Встречные платежные obligations и остаточные swaps; сохранять owner/recipient/asset/domain identity.
classes.verified_compute_application: Exact FX/route comparisons, fees, idempotent payment-state reconstruction.
classes.mechanism_lab_application: Compare batch interval, liquidity reservation и fee allocation; deadlines клиентов — hard constraints.
classes.first_experiment: Один domain,2stable assets,10 synthetic due payments. Baseline individual flows против netting+residual routing на одном state. Fiat leg только отдельная delayed-settlement модель.
classes.success_measurement: Net cost, payment deadline misses, minimum prefunding by asset, reconciliation errors при одинаковых обязательствах.
classes.funding_and_time: Atomic funding только для конкретного same-domain recipe; fiat payout/межсетевое ожидание требуют inventory и права settlement.
classes.blocking_conditions: Issuer risk, redemption/access eligibility, FX spread, provider limits, receiver/settlement constraints; токены разных эмитентов не равны из-за названия stablecoin.
classes.scaling_axis: Число recurring payment flows и клиентов с одним reusable model, а не только размер собственного flashloan.
classes.source_access: Not automatically free or admitted; per-source qualification required

classes.name: Vault shares, cash management и redemption queues
classes.product_hypothesis: Liquidity-aware cash planner: когда asset доступен, какие withdrawal costs и capacity; API evidence по vaults.
classes.clearing_application: Сопоставить liquidity deadlines со shares и допустимыми immediate conversions.
classes.verified_compute_application: Pinned preview/max/fee/rounding checks плюс воспроизводимый request lifecycle.
classes.mechanism_lab_application: Compare queue batching и withdrawal fee policy с одинаковыми obligations.
classes.first_experiment: Один synchronous vault и одна async synthetic request queue. Baseline highest displayed rate против deadline-aware feasible plan; правила pricing не смешивать.
classes.success_measurement: Недоступный к deadline cash, conversion loss, foregone yield как условная оценка, fees и inventory duration.
classes.funding_and_time: Yield за время не доход instant flashloan. Request→claim может изменять цену и требует locked capital.
classes.blocking_conditions: ERC4626 convert functions не включают все fees/slippage; preview не проверяет max limits. ERC7540 pending claim не равен готовым assets. Нужно pin implementation, не доверять одному стандарту.
classes.scaling_axis: Повторное использование интерфейсов и qualification по многим vault implementations; customer goals вместо общего highest-APY рейтинга.
classes.source_access: Not automatically free or admitted; per-source qualification required

classes.name: Collateral, refinancing и liquidation operations
classes.customer_hypothesis: Lending/treasury operators и разработчики collateral dashboards.
classes.product_hypothesis: Debt/collateral planner: смена financing source, collateral conversion, liquidation/unwind evidence.
classes.clearing_application: Композиция repayment/unlock/swap и netting совместимых obligations.
classes.verified_compute_application: Exact health/cap/rate/oracle/unwind evaluation с общим collateral state.
classes.mechanism_lab_application: Compare liquidation batching, auction incentives и close-factor regimes офлайн.
classes.first_experiment: Одна позиция,2 financing offers и3 collateral shocks; compare do-nothing/independent refinance/atomic recipe при одинаковом post-state target.
classes.success_measurement: Total borrowing/closing cost, health constraints, peak capital, failed unwind и time-dependent exposure.
classes.funding_and_time: Flash refinancing возможно только в доказанном atomic recipe; будущая процентная экономия — отдельная horizon-dependent гипотеза.
classes.blocking_conditions: Changing rates/caps/oracles, eligibility, debt dust, shared collateral, unhealthy intermediate states.
classes.scaling_axis: Переиспользуемые lender adapters и recurring risk/treasury workflows; не удваивать общий borrow capacity.
classes.source_access: Not automatically free or admitted; per-source qualification required

classes.name: Доходность, PT/YT и fixed/floating rates
classes.customer_hypothesis: Vault managers, hedgers и аналитические платформы ставок.
classes.product_hypothesis: Rate/claim optimizer: сравнение фиксированных и плавающих cashflows, maturity exposure и collateral needs.
classes.clearing_application: Netting совместимых cashflow obligations по asset/time/index, не произвольных доходностей.
classes.verified_compute_application: Индексы, maturity, margin и protocol payoff replay; existing Boros owner fixture-only.
classes.mechanism_lab_application: Compare rate-auction, collateral/margin schedules и settlement interval sensitivity.
classes.first_experiment: Один фиксированный/плавающий инструмент: positive/negative funding, oracle lag и margin stress; baseline unhedged против declared hedge.
classes.success_measurement: Cashflow volatility, total hedge cost, margin drawdown, obligation shortfall и basis risk.
classes.funding_and_time: Хранение позиции и периодические settlements требуют margin/inventory; maturity не финансируется atomic loan.
classes.blocking_conditions: Разные индексы/мaturity/settlement assets не равны; funding reversal и liquidation могут уничтожить apparent spread.
classes.scaling_axis: Большое число recurring rate exposures и risk customers; объем не гарантирован и определяется глубиной и доступом.
classes.source_access: Not automatically free or admitted; per-source qualification required

classes.name: Spot–perp, options и hedge baskets
classes.customer_hypothesis: Market makers, treasury и аналитики derivatives.
classes.product_hypothesis: Scenario-based hedge/basis research engine; портфель альтернатив с фактическими constraints.
classes.clearing_application: Net exposure и bounded multi-leg hedge; нельзя считать все CEX fills simultaneous.
classes.verified_compute_application: Mark/index/book differences, funding/borrow terms и stress replay.
classes.mechanism_lab_application: Compare margin netting, batch hedge allocation и quote priority rules.
classes.first_experiment: Один underlying,2 venues и несколько maturities с one-leg failure, disconnect и funding flip; compare feasible hedge alternatives.
classes.success_measurement: Residual exposure, drawdown scenarios, carry/fees, capital locked, fill uncertainty.
classes.funding_and_time: Обычно prefunded inventory и margin; carry не instant arbitrage.
classes.blocking_conditions: Exercise style, multiplier, settlement index, custody, sessions, borrow availability и correlated failure.
classes.scaling_axis: Reuse contract identity/risk models across families; реальные exposures и data rights ограничивают universe.
classes.source_access: Not automatically free or admitted; per-source qualification required

classes.name: Conditional claims и complete sets
classes.customer_hypothesis: Разработчики event-market analytics и market-quality tooling.
classes.product_hypothesis: Проверка complete-set parity и объяснение resolution/condition risks; read-only market integrity API.
classes.clearing_application: Совместимые outcome bundles дают общий collateral claim; condition IDs и collateral обязательны.
classes.verified_compute_application: Outcome partitions, exact lot/fee/depth и split/merge rights.
classes.mechanism_lab_application: Compare batch matching, fees и allocation с per-user constraints.
classes.first_experiment: Один pinned binary condition: complete pair vs synthetic incomplete/wrong-condition pairs; compare acquired set cost after fees с допустимым merge outcome.
classes.success_measurement: Conservation, realizable merge value, partial-fill risk, resolution/fee uncertainty.
classes.funding_and_time: Pure split/merge иногда same-domain; сбор набора через CLOB или ожидание resolution не автоматически atomic.
classes.blocking_conditions: Different question/resolver/expiry, negative-risk configuration, disputes, market access and collateral revisions.
classes.scaling_axis: Many conditions через одну grammar; forecasts и ставку на исход не выдавать за доказанный arbitrage.
classes.source_access: Not automatically free or admitted; per-source qualification required

classes.name: RWA, tokenized funds/equities и NAV rights
classes.customer_hypothesis: Qualified asset managers, custodial/issuer analytics и portfolio tools.
classes.product_hypothesis: Rights-aware NAV/redemption monitor и сравнение доступных преобразований.
classes.clearing_application: Net compatible issuer obligations только с доказанными правами; token ≠ underlying title автоматически.
classes.verified_compute_application: NAV vintage, eligibility/session, custody, corporate action and redemption evidence.
classes.mechanism_lab_application: Compare redemption windows, queue allocation и inventory buffers на офлайн модели.
classes.first_experiment: Один product dossier и stale NAV/closed session/pending redemption cases; shadow basis только при point-in-time terms.
classes.success_measurement: Realizable-after-cost basis, days capital locked, access unknowns и settlement failures.
classes.funding_and_time: Общие RWA redemption/market hours требуют времени; flashloan eligibility проверяется для конкретной мгновенной операции.
classes.blocking_conditions: Product-specific eligibility, transfer/redemption access, custody, sessions, taxes/costs если применимы; этот план не подтверждает доступ пользователя.
classes.scaling_axis: Multi-product rights evidence tooling; не обещать unlimited access к tokenized securities.
classes.source_access: Not automatically free or admitted; per-source qualification required

classes.name: Cross-domain liquidity и inventory rebalancing
classes.customer_hypothesis: Intent solvers, bridge/liquidity operators, CEX–DEX treasury teams.
classes.product_hypothesis: Read-only rebalancing planner с trapped inventory/timeout scenarios и quality/cost comparison.
classes.clearing_application: Сопоставлять встречные domain obligations, чтобы реже переносить inventory.
classes.verified_compute_application: Finality, settlement assumptions, refund/timeout and exact fee evidence.
classes.mechanism_lab_application: Compare inventory reservation, filler auctions и failure allocation policies.
classes.first_experiment: 2 domains, finite pre-funded balances,10 requests; compare transfer-every-time против netting/rebalance schedule с одной failed leg.
classes.success_measurement: Capital by domain, completion delay, failed/unknown obligations, loss scenarios и transfer costs.
classes.funding_and_time: Prefunding/credit и asynchronous settlement; interoperable order format не гарантирует atomicity.
classes.blocking_conditions: Bridge/security/finality assumptions, non-executable quote, domain-specific token identity, unavailable refund proof.
classes.scaling_axis: Customer intents и reuse resolver adapters; capacity constrained общим inventory и доступом к исполнению.
classes.source_access: Not automatically free or admitted; per-source qualification required

classes.name: Compute, inference и storage procurement
classes.customer_hypothesis: Разработчики solver/R&D workloads и data pipelines.
classes.product_hypothesis: Resource broker: выбрать допустимую вычислительную услугу по delivered result cost, deadline и quality.
classes.clearing_application: Совместить batch задач с доступными time/resource slots; сохранять deadline/privacy/data locality constraints.
classes.verified_compute_application: Повторяемый результат и actual end-to-end resource usage; stochastic inference требует task-specific quality, не просто identical bytes.
classes.mechanism_lab_application: Compare posted/reverse auction, cancellation/refund и reservation policy на synthetic providers.
classes.first_experiment: Одна deterministic route-evaluation job,3 provider profiles и outage/cold-start; compare local execution и procurement incl verification/transfer.
classes.success_measurement: Cost per correct timely result, idle capacity, p95 latency, retry/verification overhead.
classes.funding_and_time: Расходы периода услуги и оплаты, не atomic flashloan. Публичный marketplace не означает бесплатный compute.
classes.blocking_conditions: Hardware comparability, data rights/secrets, non-determinism, cancellation, provider independence и verification economics.
classes.scaling_axis: Множество клиентов и workloads при reuse task contracts; capacity по quality/location/time, не одному GPU ticker.
classes.source_access: Not automatically free or admitted; per-source qualification required

classes.name: Данные, freshness и evidence services
classes.customer_hypothesis: Solver teams, analytics, risk systems и разработчики финансовых продуктов.
classes.product_hypothesis: Market-state/evidence API: reproducible snapshots, exact route evaluation и provenance bundles.
classes.clearing_application: Batch одинаковых запросов, deduplicate raw fetches и allocate shared quotas без двойной продажи обещанной freshness.
classes.verified_compute_application: State authenticity, amount-specific correctness, freshness и completeness проверять раздельно.
classes.mechanism_lab_application: Compare freshness SLA tiers, pay-per-verified-result и query budgets в offline buyer model.
classes.first_experiment: Три data sources с shared upstream и gaps; compare naive replicas против lineage-aware cache/verification.
classes.success_measurement: Fresh qualified coverage, cost per useful receipt, correlated outage, stale false-accept и redistribution constraints.
classes.funding_and_time: Recurring service funding; atomic lender не финансирует continuous collection.
classes.blocking_conditions: Public visibility ≠ redistribution rights; metadata hash ≠ truth; synthetic demand ≠ revenue.
classes.scaling_axis: Subscription/API customers и reusable evidence; предельная стоимость новой coherent coverage важнее числа API.
classes.source_access: Not automatically free or admitted; per-source qualification required

classes.name: Blockspace, inclusion и execution-quality services
classes.customer_hypothesis: Application operators и solvers, которым важны deadlines.
classes.product_hypothesis: Inclusion-cost/latency research advisor и monitoring SLA; без sender.
classes.clearing_application: Batch совместимых demands for resources; конфликтующие writes/deadlines не объединять механически.
classes.verified_compute_application: Calibrated inclusion/latency evidence и независимый receipt, не provider self-reported guarantee.
classes.mechanism_lab_application: Compare fee bid/deadline allocation и service guarantee models.
classes.first_experiment: Recorded/synthetic fee regimes и timeout traces; compare static budget vs calibrated bounded choices на одинаковом deadline workload.
classes.success_measurement: Missed deadlines, paid cost, calibration error, regime-change robustness и shared-capacity conflicts.
classes.funding_and_time: Time-bounded service budget. Preconfirmation claim требует точных enforceable terms; не равен finalized settlement.
classes.blocking_conditions: No real inclusion evidence, unknown guarantee, changing congestion; никакого нового sender/bundle submission.
classes.scaling_axis: Распределение ресурсов многих application workloads; преимущество только после after-cost deadline benchmark.
classes.source_access: Not automatically free or admitted; per-source qualification required

classes.name: Физическая B2B-торговля: закупки, logistics, energy capacity
classes.customer_hypothesis: Procurement teams и поставщики с доступными цифровыми quotes/fulfillment records.
classes.product_hypothesis: Delivery-aware procurement planner и проверка supplier evidence; сначала digital twin одного procurement class.
classes.clearing_application: Консолидировать спрос только для одинаковых спецификаций, места/времени поставки и прав; не складывать разные качества товара.
classes.verified_compute_application: Evidence о происхождении/поставке и invoice matching; цифровая запись не доказывает физическую истину сама по себе.
classes.mechanism_lab_application: Compare supplier auctions, partial delivery, cancellations, deposits и penalties на модели.
classes.first_experiment: Один goods/service specification,2 suppliers и10 orders с lead time/partial delivery; только user-owned или synthetic data.
classes.success_measurement: Landed cost, stockouts, lead-time misses, working capital, defects и dispute outcomes.
classes.funding_and_time: Working capital, custody/delivery risk и длительный settlement; atomic flashloan обычно не подходит.
classes.blocking_conditions: Quality/location/time, logistics, freight/taxes, title, inspection, supplier contracts; общего executable public orderbook нет.
classes.scaling_axis: Повторяющиеся procurement workflows и SaaS-клиенты; отраслевой adapter обязателен, universal commerce ещё не реализован.
classes.source_access: Not automatically free or admitted; per-source qualification required
